scope: Tracked source references and named aliases, with test/example matches separated by manual source inspection; not a dynamic whole-workspace call graph or external consumer census.

consumers.role: Public dataset canonical bytes, digest of exact canonical bytes, and issuer maps delegate through shared bridge to rdf-canon. SHA256 default; parameterized profiles share algorithm.
consumers.input: General RDF1.1 quads including blank graph names; saved shape reachable.

consumers.role: Opt-in concept record digest/URN verification hashes canonical record bytes through digest_quads_with.
Optional wasm canonicalizeNQuads forwards errors as JsError; RDF/JS Dataset.equals compares canonical strings and toCanonical returns them.
consumers.input: General datasets; actual exported path affected. Native/wasm execution not rerun here.

consumers.role: hash_data signs/verifies SHA256(canonical proof configuration)||SHA256(canonical document).
consumers.input: Per-document triples only; this exact mixed-graph counterexample is not demonstrated reachable.

consumers.role: Reexported graph canonicalization defines canonical triple order, leaf order and Poseidon2 commitment inputs.
consumers.input: Per-graph triples; current dataset counterexample not a demonstrated exploit or reachability result.

consumers.role: Issued canonical labels map source triples to committed canonical leaf indices.
consumers.input: Per-graph triples; output/map agreement must be preserved.

consumers.role: Canonical proof/document strings feed signature hashData and selective-disclosure host verifier interface.
consumers.input: Triples; same qualification as VC above.

consumers.role: Separate direct rdf-canon caller for differential isomorphism checks, bypasses Sparq bridge with explicit100000-call budget.
consumers.input: Comparison encoding; a Sparq seam-only repair would not repair this independent algorithm consumer.

consumers.role: Update-fuzz comparison uses the separate nonstandard RDF1.2 implementation via ground-term guard, not upstream rdf-canon.
consumers.input: Separate implementation; standard dependency repair will not automatically change it. This phase did not replay the failure there.
